_comment: Cadence NNE kernel-shape variant of lisennet_hybrid_nc24 (conv-freq / GRU-time). Probes of the NNE scheduler (xnneSched) showed it hands five convs to the HiFi: the two 1x11 intra depthwise convs (any kernel width >= 7 stays on the DSP) and the three encoder high-band (2,5) stride-(1,3) convs (stride 3 never offloads; width 5 on the 195-wide first-stage input doesn't either). Two changes, everything else identical: intra_kernel 11 -> [5, 5] (two stacked 1x5 depthwise, RF 9) and downsample 'slice' ((2,3) conv at stride 1 + keep every 3rd bin; same 64/32/16 widths). Train into cp_lisennet_hybrid_nc24_nne.
